description:
Cast Jolene by paying its mana cost.
When Jolene enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Jolene with haste plus at least one additional token due to Jolene's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Jaheira to tap one of the Jolene tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Jolene.
Holding priority, use the ability of Jaheira to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
